gold: Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block

selector.rationale: The patient's ECG shows irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating and intermittently visible P waves, which is consistent with intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia, particularly in the context of Fontan circulation and single ventricle physiology.

rejected.label: Orthodromic Atrioventricular Reentrant Tachycardia
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence for ventricular pre-excitation or atrioventricular reentry

rejected.label: Supraventricular Tachycardia
